question: Across every calendar date in 2025, including dates with zero Delivered orders, what was the average number of Delivered orders for each weekday? Which weekday had the highest average?

action.query:
WITH calendar AS (
  SELECT DATEADD(day, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SEQ4()) - 1, '2025-01-01'::DATE) AS calendar_date
  FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 365))
), daily AS (
  SELECT c.calendar_date,
         DAYOFWEEKISO(c.calendar_date) AS weekday_num,
         SUM(IFF(o.IS_DELIVERED = TRUE, 1, 0)) AS delivered_orders
  FROM calendar c
  LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__ORDER o
    ON o.ORDER_DATE = c.calendar_date
  GROUP BY c.calendar_date
), averages AS (
  SELECT weekday_num,
         CASE weekday_num
           WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday'
           WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday'
           WHEN 7 THEN 'Sunday'
         END AS weekday,
         COUNT(*) AS calendar_dates,
         ROUND(AVG(delivered_orders), 6) AS avg_delivered_orders_per_date
  FROM daily
  GROUP BY weekday_num
)
SELECT weekday, calendar_dates, avg_delivered_orders_per_date,
       IFF(avg_delivered_orders_per_date = MAX(avg_delivered_orders_per_date) OVER (), TRUE, FALSE) AS is_highest_average
FROM averages
ORDER BY weekday_num
